messages:
harper_marketing: Final run-through tomorrow 10am PT for the "Scaling Inference: Hybrid Deployments" webinar. Need final sign-off on speaker order, slide bullets, demo failover script, and poll copy.
toni_prod: I'm good. Key benchmark bullets I want on the slide: 1) median latency <100ms on Dedicated in-region, 2) 1.8x cost savings with prefix cache on common prompts, 3) seamless fallback to hosted endpoints for high burst traffic. Keep each bullet one line.
lee_demo: I'll do the live demo showing a hybrid routing example: primary -> Dedicated pool in us-east, fallback -> hosted-small. Live demo run will be 9 minutes; pre-recorded clip ready at T+6 in case of issues. Clip: https://drive.redwood/webinars/hybrid-demo-clip.mp4
ria_ops: Streaming/recording: recorder starts 9:40. Speakers join rehearsal at 9:20 for mic checks. I'll use the channel to post status flags like :white_check_mark: or :x:. On failover, I'll post "OP: failover -> hosted-small" so producers can cue the clip.
zoe_growth: Polls: minute 3 "Primary infra concern?" options: latency / cost / deployment / security. Minute 24: "Want a sandbox invite?" yes/no. We'll use poll responses to tag leads for nurture.
deploybot: reminder: rehearsal room booked -> zoom.redwood.com/hybrid-rehearsal (passcode in calendar). Resource check: dedicated-pool-east capacity 5/8 GPUs free.
harper_marketing: Run-of-show (compact)
```
9:40 - Recording on, mic checks
10:00 - Welcome & why this matters (harper) - 3m
10:03 - Benchmark highlights (toni) - 7m
10:10 - Live hybrid demo (lee) - 9m
10:19 - Deep dive: routing + cost controls (toni) - 6m
10:25 - Panel + audience Q&A (lee, toni) - 12m
10:37 - CTA & next steps (zoe) - 3m
10:40 - Optional office hours / followups
```
harper_marketing: Demo failover script for ops & demo lead:
- primary: dedicated-pool-east (pinned)
- if 95th latency >450ms OR error rate >2% for 30s -> trigger auto-route to dedicated-fallback-b for 60s
- if fallback unavailable -> manual switch to hosted-small and cue pre-recorded clip
- ops posts status in channel and notifies #eng-oncall when manual switch occurs
lee_demo: Checklist for demo day:
- demo laptop with local recording of key flows
- env vars: PRIVATE_KEY, HOSTED_FALLBACK_KEY set
- preloaded chrome profile + screen share permissions
- backup laptop available and connected to rehearsal wifi
ria_ops: Mic plan: speakers in rehearsal room at 9:20. Quick 30s sound test each. I'll post statuses as :white_check_mark: when good.
zoe_growth: Post-webinar nurture: immediate email with benchmark PDF + recording link, day 2 sandbox invites to poll respondents who said yes, week 1 follow-up with case study CTA. Tag leads based on poll and Q&A mentions.
harper_marketing: Please react with :thumbsup: when your item is ready.
toni_prod: \u2705
lee_demo: \u2705 demo rig staged
ria_ops: \u2705 audio + recording verified
zoe_growth: \u2705 polls + nurture flow ready
harper_marketing: Nice. We'll keep this thread live for any last-minute swaps. See you at 9:20 for mic checks!
